title: docs(agents,os-regen-merge): the driver-free merge-tree probe fetches both commits
body:
Fixes #19069
Clause-②: no

## What

The driver-free `merge-tree` probe in `AGENTS.md` (§ Multi-agent working discipline, item 11, the "Corollary" bullet) and its copy in the `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` header now **fetch both commits into the throwaway bare clone**, and name the misread the old recipe produced: exit 1 with no tree id, `not something we can merge`, is a missing object, never a conflict.

- **`scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` header**: this is now the one copy of the commands. The header writes BASE and HEAD as angle-bracket placeholders; they are spelled as words here:
  ```
  git clone -q --bare --shared . PROBE.git
  git --git-dir=PROBE.git fetch -q . BASE:refs/b HEAD:refs/h
  git --git-dir=PROBE.git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only refs/b refs/h
  rm -rf PROBE.git          # exit 1 + a tree id + the paths = really conflicted
  ```
  The header also carries the mechanism, why the defect stayed hidden, and the measurement table below.
- **`AGENTS.md`**: the false clause "a throwaway bare clone that shares the object store" and the two command lines are gone. In their place are the rule (FETCH both commits, because `--shared` may copy only what `refs/heads/**` reach), the missing-object sentence, and a pointer to the header. The ⛔ `-c merge.os-regen.driver=` / `-c merge.os-regen.driver=false` sentence keeps its words and is only reflowed. **Net 0 lines** (1108 → 1108, ceiling 1116). The widest edited line is 92 bytes, under the 120-byte rule.

The commands moved to one place. That is deliberate: two verbatim copies are how this defect got printed twice, and `AGENTS.md` carries rules while the script header is the authority on detail.

## Mechanism: re-measured in this container, git 2.43.0

The card's root cause holds (a shallow source checkout), with one refinement.

| reading | value |
|---|---|
| `git -C /home/user/objectstack rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` | `true`, with `.git/shallow` holding 1 graft (`ebc6afe8d`) |
| `git clone --bare --shared` from the primary checkout | exit 0; `objects/info/` **empty**; the clone is itself shallow; its refs are the 4 `refs/heads/**` only |
| git names the cause when asked for `--local` | `warning: source repository is shallow, ignoring --local` |
| `--reject-shallow` | `fatal: source repository is shallow, reject to clone.` (exit 128) |
| `--reference /home/user/objectstack/.git` | `fatal: reference repository '/home/user/objectstack/.git' is shallow` (exit 128). This candidate is dead. |
| dark leg: `cat-file -t ba9f0299086c` (reachable only through `refs/remotes/origin/claude/issue-16612-…`) | exit 128, `could not get object info` |
| control leg: `cat-file -t 013f97df93ed` (local `main`, a `refs/heads` tip) | `commit`, exit 0 |
| **refinement:** the same clone taken from a **linked worktree** of the same shallow checkout | alternates **written** (`/home/user/objectstack/.git/objects`), and the clone reports non-shallow (`false`). The store it points at is still shallow: in that probe `rev-list --count f6ccca4a4` exits 128 with `Failed to traverse parents of commit ebc6afe8d…` |

So the fetch-less recipe's answer depended on three hidden variables: whether the source is shallow, whether it is the primary checkout or a linked worktree, and whether some local branch happened to contain both commits. The fetch removes all three. `.` in the fetch is the cwd checkout, not `PROBE.git`: the unreferenced base was fetched from it. Names resolve in your checkout (`origin/main`, `HEAD`), never in the probe.

## Two-leg proof on this shallow checkout (verbatim)

Synthetic pairs over a routed path, `packages/spec/spec-changes.json`, built with `commit-tree` so that **no ref reaches them**. X = `013f97df9` (`origin/main~3`).
- base `7e44271c8`: line 12 → `action.execute-base-side`
- conflicting head `6ff98192f`: the same line → `action.execute-head-side`
- clean head `f000e76dc`: line 300, 288 lines away

Ground truth is `git merge-file` on the three blobs: the conflicting pair exits 1 and the clean pair exits 0.

The last block is the reverse leg. On the same pair, from the same cwd, the fetch-less recipe answers exit 1 with an empty stdout. That is a false conflict over a clean head. A non-shallow source was also measured, on a synthetic repository: alternates are written as documented, and the same three lines answer there too.

- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`: `AGENTS.md is 1108 lines (ceiling 1116; headroom 8)` · `widest table row is 768 bytes (pin 768; headroom 0)`
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`: `34 file(s) clean (pattern /#[0-9]{3,}/g)`
- `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose`: `2 instruction surface(s) name all 6 registered governed surfaces`
- `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges`: self-test green (454 assertions)
- `pnpm check:bash32-floor`: `32 tracked shell file(s) … name no bash 4+ construct`
- `pnpm check:nul-bytes`: `OK (scanned 9584 text file(s) … no raw ASCII control bytes)`
- `bash scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh --self-test`, the edited script's own suite and outside the derivation: `✓ os-regen-merge self-test: all cases pass.` (`VERDICT command-exit 0` under `os-verify-lock.sh`)
- `node scripts/check-published-list-mirrors.mjs`, whose roster sits under `scripts`: `OK: 1 published list mirror(s) match`

## Acceptance notes

- **Two sibling copies of the fetch-less probe sit outside this card's claimed file surface and are not touched.** Both are reported to the seat.
  - `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` line 35 names `clone --bare --shared` as the conflict-proof instrument, and line 30 feeds it `origin/main` plus a fetched PR ref. These are exactly the refs the shallow primary-checkout clone lacks. The file is Tier S and line-ratcheted.
  - `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/README.md` lines 146-147 give `git clone --shared --no-local . /tmp/driverless` followed by `merge-tree … BRANCH_A BRANCH_B`. This was measured on a synthetic **non-shallow** repo. `--no-local` leaves no alternates, and a non-bare clone lands the source's branches as `origin/BRANCH_A`. The command as written answers exit 1, `merge-tree: BRANCH_A - not something we can merge` / `Did you mean this? origin/BRANCH_A`.
- The `os-regen-merge.sh` header's own intro line "The corollary AGENTS.md §11 leaves unstated" is stale, because `AGENTS.md` now states it. It is outside the claimed surface and left as is.
- NOT MEASURED: git versions other than 2.43.0, a source that carries tags (this one has none), and macOS.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:`AGENTS.md` 第 11 条「本地 merge-tree 不等于 GitHub 可合并性」那一段,和 `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` 头部的同一条探针配方。现在克隆之后多一步:把 base、head 两个提交显式 fetch 进探针。另外写明:exit 1 却打印不出树 id(`not something we can merge`)是对象缺失,不是冲突。命令只在脚本头部留一份,`AGENTS.md` 留规则加指针,行数净零。

**为什么改**:在浅克隆的主检出上照抄旧配方时,`--shared` 静默不共享对象,探针里根本没有 `origin/main` 或 PR head。merge-tree 于是以 exit 1 作答,和真冲突是同一个退出码,一个干净的 PR 会被读成冲突。后果是无谓的解冲突轮次,甚至有人据此改写本来干净的 head。旧配方有时对、有时错,取决于从哪个检出运行、此刻有没有某个本地分支恰好包含那两个提交,所以长期没被发现。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改文档与脚本注释,不动任何运行代码。探针多一次本地 fetch:在浅检出上,克隆加 fetch 实测 5 到 6 秒,与原来单独克隆同量级;非浅仓上 fetch 近乎零成本。回滚方式是 revert 本 PR。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:审阅后给出批准(`AGENTS.md` 属于 Tier H,需要维护者本人的 APPROVED 评审)。
